links.label: Maltiverse IP page
links.notes: Single-page web UI of the Maltiverse lookup (P154); shown when the keyed module is skipped or blocked. Path form follows the API objects (/ip/{ip}); not checked live (JS page).

links.label: Maltiverse hostname page
links.notes: Single-page web UI of the Maltiverse hostname lookup (P154); not checked live (JS page).

links.label: Maltiverse sample page
links.notes: Single-page web UI of the Maltiverse sample lookup (P154); not checked live (JS page).

links.label: Pulsedive indicator page
links.notes: Pulsedive web indicator page (base64 of the indicator in ?ioc=). Viewing the page never triggers analyze.php (P160 cond 2); not checked live.

links.label: StopForumSpam IP check
links.notes: StopForumSpam web IP check (read-only page; never add.php). The manual fallback while stopforumspam.api is licence-blocked under the corporate profile (P164 cond 2). E-mail addresses and usernames get no link (hash-only policy).
